It's a  marginalized colony of Morocco. 

They are highly oppressed set of people in Morocco.  While I was in Casablanca, i had the opportunity to ask questions and realized that most of the cleaners and laborers were Sahrawinian from  Western Sahara. 
They have been clamoring for independence from Morocco
